property_summary: For any valid input, the function transfer should return true on successful completion; the buggy version always returns false, breaking this invariant.

For any admissible input that does not cause an arithmetic error, the return value of transfer(...) must equal the overall success of the low-level calls, which in the reference is true; the mutant returns false regardless.

For any admissible input, the reference C.transfer(...) returns true (the literal value it returns), while the buggy version returns false for some admissible input, violating the invariant that the return value equals the deterministic constant true.
For any admissible input, the reference C.transfer call returns true; the buggy version returns false for any input, violating the return value invariant.

For any admissible input, the return value of transfer must equal the logical AND of the success statuses of all internal low-level calls, which in the reference is always true, but the mutant returns false regardless.
